titleZh: 过关斩将：美国大型交易必须通过的审批关卡
titleEn: Gatekeeper Gauntlet: The Regulatory Approvals Every Major U.S. Deal Must Clear
excerptZh: 签约只是起点。从HSR反垄断、CFIUS国安审查、SEC证券监管到行业许可与州级审批——一篇文章看懂美国大型交易从签约到交割的监管全图。
excerptEn: Signing is just the starting line. From HSR antitrust and CFIUS national security to SEC review, industry licenses, and state-level oversight — a complete regulatory map from signing to closing.
